events.title: REDBULL GAMING HUB SOCIAL & TUTORIALS
events.subtitle: AUG. 25 | REDBULL GAMING HUB
events.description: We hung out at the hub, learned about Unity, creating art for games, and held an info session about Met Game Studios!

events.title: MET GAMES CLUB FAIR
events.subtitle: AUG. 26 | ROGERS COMMUNICATION CENTER (RCC) - LOBBY
events.description: Campus groups at our fair booths in the RCC lobby

events.title: ORIENTATION IN THE CATALYST!
events.subtitle: SEPT. 9 | ROGERS COMMUNICATION CENTER (RCC) - THE CATALYST
events.description: Our first open call meeting to join, learn more details about us, and meet fellow members of the studio.

events.title: PITCH DAY - GAME CONCEPT VOTING FAIR
events.subtitle: SEPT. 22 | ROGERS COMMUNICATION CENTER (RCC) - THE CATALYST
events.description: Present your game concepts for a chance to be selected! The event was held in a booth-style presentation format at the Catalyst. The winning game concept to be developed for the year was announced: Beats & Brains!

events.title: PICTURE DAY! FREE STUDIO HEADSHOTS
events.subtitle: SEPT. 30 | ROGERS COMMUNICATION CENTER (RCC) - THE CATALYST
events.description: Free headshot event taken by a professional photographer!

events.title: INDUSTRY GUEST LECTURE WITH STEFAN ZAMFIR
events.subtitle: OCT. 24 | VIRTUAL
events.description: Our first industry guest lecture! He has been in the industry for two decades as a game designer, producer, and operations manager through his dedicated work at Gameloft, and presented his incredible lecture: "FAIL FAST, PLAY FASTER: The Prototyping Journey in Game Design"

events.title: INDUSTRY GUEST LECTURE WITH ROBERT BUTTS
events.subtitle: NOV. 10 | ROGERS COMMUNICATION CENTER (RCC) - THE CATALYST
events.description: Industry guest lecturer- Rob is a game developer with experience in QA, production, and studio management.

events.title: GAMES NIGHT! & FALL GAME JAM INFO SESSION
events.subtitle: NOV. 14 | VIRTUAL
events.description: Participants joined us for an evening of fun as we played games (as voted on in Discord)! We also conducted an information session about our upcoming game jam.

events.title: FALL GAME JAM
events.subtitle: DEC. 9 - DEC. 30 | BAMPOT HOUSE - 201 HARBORD ST, TORONTO
events.description: Throughout the month, participants worked diligently to develop their game prototypes, each aligning with the designated theme. They utilized various development software to bring their creations to life, ensuring they were ready for submission on itch.io by the deadline. As a public event at Bampot we had many incomers vote for their favorite game (and potentially the winning game!). Bampot hosted a lively event with karaoke, games, tea, cocktails, and plenty of social fun, making it a memorable occasion for everyone involved.

events.title: BMO NXT LVL WINTER GAME JAM
events.subtitle: FEB. 13 - FEB. 20 | SHELDON & TRACY LEVY STUDENT LEARNING CENTRE (SLC) - FLOOR 6
events.description: Fifteen teams registered to showcase a game, setting a new record at our studio! It was gearing up to be our busiest game jam yet. Each podium winner received a cash prize and a chance to join us at the Level Up Showcase 2026, where they had their very own booth to display their amazing game! Every vote truly mattered!

events.title: ROBLOX WORKSHOP
events.subtitle: MAR. 19 & MAR. 26 | REDBULL GAMING HUB
events.description: Open to all students and experience levels, these workshops introduced the essentials of Roblox Studio development and environment design. Using Roblox Studio, students learned the basics of design, navigation, building, and lighting, and published their own playable environment and user-generated content.

events.title: LEVEL UP SHOWCASE
events.subtitle: APR. 7 | SHERATON CENTRE
events.description: After a school year of hard work developing Beats & Brains, we took our game and the game jam winners to the biggest student video game showcase in Ontario- where we took home a trophy for 2nd place in the People's Choice category (by Ubisoft)
